determine if there is deviation toward the side of the anomalous vein (rightward shift) and check for ipsilateral lung hypoplasia.", "On cross-sectional imaging (CT), trace the course of the anomalous vein to confirm drainage into the inferior vena cava and identify any systemic arterial supply originating from the abdominal aorta to the lower lung lobe."]}, {"category": "detection", "trigger": "When assessing the superior mediastinum on a PA chest radiograph to differentiate vascular anomalies from pathological masses.", "steps": ["Trace the contour of the left superior mediastinum looking for a smooth, tubular, or convex opacity extending inferiorly from the level of the aortic arch.", "Compare the density and margins of the widening to typical lymphadenopathy or tumors; A 58-year-old male patient with a history of alcohol abuse presents with acute onset of dysphonia. A chest X-ray was performed to investigate the cause. Which of the following findings on the chest X-ray could most likely correlate with the patient's symptom of dysphonia, considering the potential diagnosis of tracheal squamous cell carcinoma?

A) A clearly defined mass in the right lower lobe
B) A peripheral middle lobe infiltrate
C) Enlargement of the left hilum
D) Blurring of the left heart border
E) Right-sided pleural effusion
F) Anterior mediastinal widening
